subject: OrchidAI premium coverage and committed discount inquiry
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@orchidai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-28T16:12:00-04:00
Subject: Inquiry: premium coverage + committed discount

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the intro last week. We’re getting closer to an internal decision and I need a clear picture of Redwood’s premium support packaging and how discounts can be applied to committed capacity. High level items we care about: 

- SLA: we need a 99.99% uptime guarantee for our production inference endpoints (dedicated capacity)
- Escalation & response: 1-hour response for Sev1, 4-hour for Sev2; on-call 24x7 preferred
- Credits: how do you credit downtime and what are the payout mechanics?
- Pricing: we’re planning a 12-month committed spend for reserved GPUs; what discount bands do you offer versus on-demand sizes?
- Add-ons: can we add a 24x7 retainer for faster escalation and a named escalation path?

I attached our Q3 usage forecast to give you scale. Can you share a straightforward option (recommended tier + expected monthly cost after discounts) so I can take it to procurement? If it helps, our expected committed spend is in the $400k-$650k/month range depending on sizing.

Appreciate a quick turn on this; we’re aiming to finalize vendor terms by mid-April.

Best,
Lina Park
Head of Platform
OrchidAI
[Attachment: OrchidAI_Forecast_Q3_v1.xlsx]
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina@orchidai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-28T17:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: premium coverage + committed discount

Lina,

Thanks for the clear summary and the forecast — that helps a lot. High-level response: we can support the uptime and response targets you listed, with two paths depending on how much operational ownership you want on your side: Hosted + Dedicated capacity (Redwood manages infra and escalation) or Private (VPC/on-prem) with a stronger SI-style retainer.

Quick bullets:
- SLA: we can offer a 99.99% uptime SLO on Dedicated with a Platinum response tier (1-hour P1, 4-hour P2) + credits (credit schedule tied to minutes of downtime; typically up to full monthly invoice for extreme breaches).
- Pricing: for a 12-month reserved commit in the range you noted we typically start at a 12-18% baseline commitment discount, with room to increase with linear scaling or multi-year.
- Retainer/Oncall: 24x7 named escalation + playbook comes as a paid retainer add-on. We include a monthly oncall allowance with the Platinum plan and then an hourly overage rate.

I’d like to propose we do a short 30-minute call to agree a target SKU and then I’ll put together a formal Commercial Proposal and SOW. I’m attaching our SKU matrix and a sample SOW language for how credits and oncall are handled.

Proposed immediate next step: 30-min call tomorrow or Friday. Marissa (CC) will help with commercial math and Karthik (pricing) will be looped for limits/approval.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Premium_Support_SKUs_v3.pdf]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tom Rinehart <tom.rinehart@orchidai.com>
Date: 2028-03-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Platinum coverage + 12-month commitment (summary)

Hi Lina / Tom,

Thanks again for the forecast and the call request. Below is a concise commercial proposal to review internally at OrchidAI. If this aligns, we’ll follow with a formal commercial proposal and a draft SOW (DocuSign-ready).

Summary proposal (high level):
- Term: 12 months reserved commit (starts on sign).
- Pricing: 15% commitment discount off list for the reserved GPU pool for the 12-month term. Estimated effective range based on your forecast: $425k-$610k/month after discount, depending on final sizing and zone split.
- SLA: Platinum 99.99% monthly uptime target for Dedicated endpoints.
  - Response SLA: P1 (Severity 1) = 1-hour response, P2 = 4-hour response.
  - Credit schedule: tiered credits for minutes of unavailability per monthly period; credit exposure capped at 30% of the affected month’s invoice.
- Oncall/retainer: 24x7 named escalation retainer = $35k/month (includes up to 40 incident-hours/month). Hourly overage = $250/hr.
- Implementation: one-time onboarding/runbook & SLA acceptance fee = $50k (covers monitoring, playbook integration, and acceptance testing).
- Add-ons: private VPC deployment or multi-region active-passive failover are available (priced separately).

Attachments and next assets:
- Draft SOW + standard support appendix (attached).
- Full SKU & credit matrix (attached)
- If this is acceptable as a starting point, we’ll produce a formal Commercial Proposal and SOW with the exact seat/instance counts and a DocuSign route.

Quick ask: can you confirm (a) target monthly commit you’d like priced exactly, and (b) whether OrchidAI prefers a 12- or 24-month term (we can show a 20% pricing option for 24 months)?

If you’d like, Marissa can join a call Friday to walk through commercial math.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Redwood_Premium_Support_SKUs_v3.pdf, SOW-draft-orchidai.docx]
